nl_request: Find the support cases opened on or after 2024-11-17 and before 2025-09-08 with a severity of at least 2, for customers on the pro or enterprise tier, that have at least two refund-request notes and at least one refund greater than 750 with an approval date recorded. Return the IDs of the matching support cases.
reference_sql:
SELECT sc.id
FROM support_cases AS sc
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = sc.customer_id
WHERE c.tier IN ('pro', 'enterprise')
  AND sc.opened_at >= '2024-11-17' AND sc.opened_at < '2025-09-08'
  AND sc.severity >= 2
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_notes AS n
    WHERE n.case_id = sc.id AND n.note_type = 'refund_request'
  ) >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM refunds AS r
    WHERE r.case_id = sc.id AND r.amount > 750 AND r.approved_at IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY sc.id
